Tooltips.ACHIEVEMENT_EARNED_BODY: Open your profile to view your achievements and track your progress.
Tooltips.CLASSIC_FROM_DAILY_BODY: Daily challenge complete. Classic mode lets you keep solving riddles at your own pace.
Tooltips.GAME_COINS_BODY: Tap this button to buy coins to fuel your adventure.
Tooltips.GAME_HINT_BODY: Tap Hint to reveal a helpful letter when you get stuck. Hints cost coins.
Tooltips.GAME_MULTIPLAYER_BODY: Tap Multiplayer to find an opponent or challenge a friend.
Tooltips.GAME_SKIP_BODY: Tap this button to move past this riddle when you are stuck. Skips cost coins.
Tooltips.HINT_AFTER_WRONG_BODY: That guess missed. Tap Hint to reveal a helpful letter and keep going.
Tooltips.LEADERBOARD_FIFTH_CORRECT_BODY: Five correct answers! Open your profile to see how you rank.
Tooltips.PROFILE_ACHIEVEMENTS_BODY: Open this section to see every achievement you have unlocked.
Tooltips.PROFILE_RANKS_BODY: Open ranks to see every rank, its level requirement, and the rewards you can unlock.
Tooltips.PROFILE_DAILY_PUZZLES_BODY: This shows how many daily challenges you have completed.
Tooltips.PROFILE_IDENTITY_BODY: Your avatar, username live here. Tap on them to change them.
Tooltips.PROFILE_LEADERBOARD_BODY: Open the leaderboard to compare XP, wins, and streaks with other players.
Tooltips.PROFILE_PROGRESSION_BODY: Your rank, XP level, and progress bar show how close you are to the next level.
Tooltips.PROFILE_STATISTICS_BODY: Open statistics for a deeper breakdown of your gameplay performance.
Tooltips.PROFILE_STATS_BODY: These cards summarize your streak, words guessed, win rate, and average guesses.
Tooltips.PROFILE_TREASURE_BODY: Open your Treasure Chest to view your coins and visit the coin shop.
Tooltips.SUBMIT_ANSWER_BODY: When every slot is filled, tap Submit to check your guess.
